title: Tiny, cute diamond
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="g1" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#a8e6ff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4fc3f7"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="g2" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#81d4fa"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#29b6f6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="g3" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4dd0e1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0097a7"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="g4" x1="1" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b3e5fc"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0288d1"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="32" ry="30" fill="#4fc3f7" opacity="0.12"/>

  <!-- top crown (table) -->
  <polygon points="38,30 62,30 58,42 42,42" fill="url(#g1)" stroke="#c8f0ff" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- left facet -->
  <polygon points="38,30 42,42 32,55 25,42" fill="url(#g2)" stroke="#b3e5fc" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- top-right facet -->
  <polygon points="62,30 68,42 58,42" fill="url(#g3)" stroke="#80deea" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- center facet -->
  <polygon points="42,42 58,42 55,56 45,56" fill="#e1f5fe" stroke="#b3e5fc" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- bottom-left facet -->
  <polygon points="32,55 42,42 45,56 38,68" fill="url(#g4)" stroke="#81d4fa" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- bottom-right facet -->
  <polygon points="58,42 68,42 70,56 55,56" fill="url(#g2)" stroke="#b3e5fc" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- left side bottom -->
  <polygon points="25,42 32,55 38,68 30,62" fill="#26c6da" stroke="#4dd0e1" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- right side bottom -->
  <polygon points="68,42 75,50 70,56" fill="#0097a7" stroke="#4dd0e1" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- bottom point -->
  <polygon points="45,56 55,56 50,74" fill="#80deea" stroke="#b3e5fc" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <polygon points="38,68 45,56 50,74" fill="#4fc3f7" stroke="#81d4fa" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <polygon points="55,56 70,56 50,74" fill="#29b6f6" stroke="#4fc3f7" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- highlights -->
  <polygon points="42,35 46,35 44,40" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="47" y1="46" x2="50" y2="50" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#ffffff">
    <polygon points="22,28 24,32 28,32 25,35 26,39 22,36 18,39 19,35 16,32 20,32"/>
    <polygon points="76,25 77,28 80,28 78,30 79,33 76,31 73,33 74,30 72,28 75,28"/>
    <polygon points="80,60 81,62 83,62 81,64 82,66 80,64 78,66 79,64 77,62 79,62"/>
  </g>

  <!-- cute face on center facet -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="49" r="1.5" fill="#0d47a1"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="49" r="1.5" fill="#0d47a1"/>
  <path d="M47,52 Q50,54.5 53,52" stroke="#0d47a1" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="52" rx="2" ry="1.2" fill="#ff8a80" opacity="0.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="52" rx="2" ry="1.2" fill="#ff8a80" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
